lastCompletedStory.title: Implement the deterministic pre-PR ship sequence (runShipPhase)

openQuestions: runShipPhase's runGatesFn/bumpFn/finalizeFn are required injected functions with no production factory wired yet (deliberately deferred): US-004 (wire the shipping phase into the sidecar loop) must build the host wiring, e.g. a runGatesFn that spawns DEFAULT_GATES_COMMAND ('bun run check:all') via spawnFn and captures the output tail on failure, plus bumpFn/finalizeFn closures wrapping runShipBump/finalizeCycleClose with their own real spawnFn/clock/read/write deps (see ship-bump.ts and ship-finalize.ts option shapes, which differ from ship-runner.ts's loop.ts-style SpawnFn).
nextStoryContext: US-003 (PR-create and merge-mode step) consumes runShipPhase's ready-for-pr result directly: result.prdSnapshot feeds composePrTitle/composePrBody (src/release/pr-body.ts, US-001) to build the gh pr create title/body without any LLM authoring step, and result.branchName is the already-pushed branch to open the PR from. ready-for-pr also carries bumpResult and finalizeResult (issueId, issueBackend) which US-003's merge-mode/issue-close logic will need (mirrors cam-ship.md Steps 7-9: gh pr create, auto-merge, reviewer-artifact PR comment, ci-gated merge-watch enrichment vs immediate-mode issue close). Note ship-runner.ts's gates-failed/bump-failed/finalize-failed/push-failed/on-main/prd-incomplete/no-commits-ahead results are NOT this story's concern (US-004 wires the caller that reacts to those); US-003 only needs the ready-for-pr success path plus whatever escalation hook the PRD specifies for a failed PR-create/merge call.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure TypeScript state machine wrapping existing internal modules (loop.ts SpawnFn, ship-bump.ts, ship-finalize.ts, pr-body.ts); no new external library import.
